description: Discover chain support. Returns the chains where the Ankr Advanced API indexer is available (token balances, NFTs, holders, transfers, prices). IMPORTANT: the raw-RPC tools (getTransaction, getLogs, getBlock) and rpcCall are NOT limited to this list — they reach ANY chain Ankr serves (200+ EVM mainnets/testnets plus non-EVM like solana, btc, xrp, ton, near, aptos, and cosmos chains); just pass the chain slug as it appears in rpc.ankr.com/<chain>. suiChains are served over gRPC rather than by the proxy and have their own sui* tools. TORPC tier-2 compression is applied by the proxy on supported EVM chains, and other proxy chains pass through unchanged; suiChains are shaped in this server instead, so a Sui reply can be tier 1 or 2 with no proxy involved — check _meta.tier and _meta.tier_source for what was applied and by whom.
name: listChains
title: List supported chains
